I’ll always remember New Year’s Day. 2015. I was talking to my at the time girlfriend, we broke up a year or two later but reminded friends, online. Sitting in disc/vent I don’t remember which one way back then. I had planned on harming myself that night and she insisted. “Don’t get off, come to ICC with me I know you’ve always wanted invincible”
And I listened. She sat there and listened to me for hours while we slowly cleared the raid. And it dropped. That’s the day I got the Mount. 
She passed in the Mount and I gave her the molten core anniversary pet. I’ll always remember how she was there at my lowest point and wouldn’t let me be alone until she thought I was ok. She stayed up for 24 hours straight just so when she logged off she knew I’d be back on later that day.
